name: TSM Corporation
old_description: TSM is a full-service manufacturer of custom components for automotive powertrain, driveline, and chassis applications.
about:
TSM Corporation operates from Auburn Hills, Michigan, where it was founded in 1978. The company began with 10 employees, a single rotary dial machine, and three drill presses, and has since grown into a multi-location operation with 200,000 square feet of production space and more than 180 employees.

The company provides full-service manufacturing of custom components for automotive powertrain, driveline, and chassis applications. Its capabilities span the entire process from design through start of production, supported by over 40 dedicated machining centers, 200-plus production machines, and 24/7 operations. TSM manages every step of development, including in-house re-tooling, design optimization, and program launch.

TSM serves global automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers across more than 40 vehicle platforms. Notable engagements include taking over a failing intake manifold program for a leading global OEM and delivering it within five weeks, and redesigning a structural support for a major automaker to reduce mass by 25 percent while consolidating two part numbers into one.

The company emphasizes agile production as a core differentiator, describing its responsiveness as part of its DNA. TSM’s quality culture engages all employees and business partners, underpinned by IATF 16949 and ISO 14001 certifications, and aims to deploy customized manufacturing technologies optimized for each product.
